With its bold front grille, sculpted body lines, rugged-inspired styling, and confident road presence, this popular Toyota brings personality and practicality together beautifully. Whether you're navigating busy city streets, exploring scenic Pacific Northwest highways, or packing up for a weekend getaway, the RAV4 XLE Premium delivers the dependable performance, spacious comfort, and thoughtful convenience that make it an outstanding companion for your everyday adventures. Responsive acceleration and composed handling make the Civic enjoyable to drive, while EPA estimates of 31 MPG city and 40 MPG highway deliver impressive efficiency.The EX trim brings desirable comfort and technology upgrades, including a power moonroof, dual-zone automatic climate control, push-button start, remote engine start and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. Black cloth seating, a power-adjustable driver's seat and a reclining, split-folding rear bench provide everyday comfort and versatility. The spacious rear cargo area makes this hatchback particularly practical for luggage, groceries and recreational gear.Technology includes Honda's 7-inch Display Audio touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, Bluetooth connectivity, SiriusXM capability and an upgraded 180-watt audio system with eight speakers. Steering-wheel audio controls and illuminated instrumentation keep essential functions conveniently accessible.Honda Sensing driver-assistance technology is a major highlight, featuring Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Collision Mitigation Braking System with Forward Collision Warning, Lane Keeping Assist and Road Departure Mitigation. These systems provide valuable support during highway driving and changing traffic conditions.Honda LaneWatch adds a passenger-side camera view when signaling right, helping monitor the adjacent lane. A multi-angle rearview camera, automatic high-beam headlights, electronic stability control and hill-start assist contribute further everyday confidence.The Civic Hatchback earned a place on Car and Driver's 2020 Editors' Choice list, with reviewers recognizing its excellent driving dynamics, efficient turbocharged engine and unusually practical interior. CARTIME has this breathtaking C8 Corvette Stingray Convertible in stock and ready for a test drive  a mid-engine American icon with 51,039 miles and an open-air driving experience that turns every road into an event.About This 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Convertible The C8 generation Corvette was a seismic shift for General Motors  the first time in the model's 67-year history that Chevy moved the engine behind the driver. The result is a supercar-grade machine that competes with exotics costing two or three times as much. At 51,039 miles, this example has been driven and enjoyed, but is well within the range where a Corvette's performance components are fully broken in and operating at their best. This is a convertible body style, meaning you get the full Stingray experience with the wind in your hair and the exhaust note surrounding you with nothing between you and the Southern California sky.2020 Chevrolet Corvette Performance and EngineA 6.2-Liter V8 That Means Business Under the rear lid sits Chevrolet's legendary LT2 6.2-liter V8  naturally aspirated, high-revving, and tuned specifically for the C8 platform. This engine produces 490 horsepower in standard tune and 495 horsepower with the performance exhaust option, and it pulls hard from just about any speed. The power delivery is immediate and linear, with a soundtrack that ranges from a burbling idle to a full-throated roar at wide-open throttle. 8-Speed Dual-Clutch Transmission Paired to that V8 is an 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission  not a traditional torque-converter automatic, but a lightning-fast PDK-style unit that swaps gears in milliseconds. In automatic mode it's seamless and refined for daily driving. In manual mode using the paddle shifters, it responds with the kind of precision you'd expect from a European sports car. Rear-wheel drive keeps the character pure and driver-focused, and the mid-engine layout gives this Corvette a near-perfect 40/60 front-to-rear weight distribution that transforms how it handles compared to every previous generation.Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Features and InteriorOpen-Air Driving, Closed-Cockpit Refinement The Stingray Convertible uses a retractable hardtop-style roof system that folds away quickly, keeping the structural rigidity of the coupe while delivering an open-air experience. Inside, the cockpit is driver-centric and genuinely modern  a sharp departure from previous Corvette generations. The center console acts almost as a fighter-jet-style tunnel, with toggles and controls angled toward the driver. The 12-inch configurable instrument cluster and 8-inch infotainment touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep the technology current. The Stingray trim brings a high level of standard equipment including Bose audio, heated and ventilated seats, and a choice of performance-tuned suspension options.Chevrolet Corvette Reliability and Ownership The C8 Corvette has earned strong early reliability marks from owners and automotive press alike. General Motors spent years engineering this platform and the LT2 V8 is derived from a long line of dependable small-block engines that have millions of miles of real-world data behind them. Common owner feedback highlights the quality of the interior materials  a major leap over previous generations  and the surprisingly livable daily-driver character despite the supercar-level performance numbers. At 51,039 miles, the powertrain is mature and any early production quirks would have been addressed. Routine maintenance  oil changes, tire rotations, and brake inspections  is all this Corvette should need at this mileage. Enthusiast communities for the C8 are active and well-resourced, making ownership support easy to find.Why Buy From CARTIME in South Gate, CA CARTIME is located in South Gate, in Los Angeles County, and has built a strong reputation serving car buyers across the greater Los Angeles area. You'll get a straight-talking team, a properly presented vehicle, and the kind of local accountability that comes from a dealer embedded in the South Gate and greater LA community.Financing a Used Chevrolet Corvette Near South Gate Financing a performance vehicle like the Corvette is straightforward when you work with a dealer that has established lender relationships. CARTIME works with a range of financing sources to help buyers in different credit situations get behind the wheel. Whether you have excellent credit, are rebuilding, or are somewhere in the middle, the finance team will work to find a solution that fits your situation. See the current price listed on this page and reach out to get pre-qualified before you even walk through the door  or apply online and save time at the dealership.Frequently Asked QuestionsIs the 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray a good buy? Absolutely. The 2020 C8 Corvette Stingray represents one of the best performance values in automotive history. It offers supercar performance  490 horsepower, a 0-60 time under 3 seconds in ideal conditions, and world-class handling  at a price point that undercuts comparable European sports cars dramatically. Used examples at this mileage represent even stronger value. How many miles is too many on a used C8 Corvette? The LT2 V8 engine in the C8 Corvette is built on decades of small-block Chevy engineering and is well-proven for long-term durability. With proper maintenance, these engines routinely last well beyond 100,000 miles. At 51,039 miles, this Corvette is well within a healthy ownership window with plenty of life ahead of it. What does the Stingray trim include on the 2020 Corvette? The Stingray is the entry-level trim of the C8 Corvette, but "entry-level" is relative. It comes standard with the 6.2-liter V8, 8-speed dual-clutch transmission, a 12-inch digital instrument cluster, 8-inch infotainment with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bose premium audio, performance exhaust availability, and a range of available packages including the Z51 performance package. Is the convertible Corvette as rigid as the coupe? Yes  the C8 Convertible uses a retractable hardtop system that maintains much of the structural rigidity of the coupe. Engineers designed the convertible from the ground up alongside the coupe, not as an afterthought, and owners report minimal flex or cowl shake even on aggressive canyon roads. Does the 2020 Corvette hold its value? The C8 generation Corvette has shown exceptional value retention. Early production years, which include 2020, have been particularly sought after by collectors and enthusiasts due to the historic nature of the first mid-engine Corvette. STING-GRAY CLEAR-COAT, 3.6L V6, 8-SPEED AUTOMATIC, COMMAND-TRAC 4WD AND OPEN-AIR JEEP ADVENTURE.Sting-Gray Clear-Coat gives this Gladiator Overland a distinctive look, complemented by body-color fender flares, 18-inch Granite Crystal aluminum wheels, side steps and fog lamps. The Black Freedom Top 3-piece hardtop ($1,195) adds removable roof panels for open-air driving, along with a rear sliding window, defroster and Freedom Panel storage bag. Few pickups combine a usable cargo bed with the unmistakable character of a Jeep.The 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 produces 285 horsepower and 260 lb-ft of torque, paired with the optional $2,000 8-speed automatic transmission. Command-Trac part-time four-wheel drive, a two-speed transfer case, heavy-duty Dana 44 front and rear axles, skid plates and a 3.73 axle ratio bring genuine Trail Rated capability. The factory EPA rating is 17 MPG city, 22 highway and 19 combined.The $1,595 8.4-inch Radio and Premium Audio Group is a standout upgrade. Uconnect 4C NAV integrates an 8.4-inch touchscreen, GPS navigation, HD Radio, SiriusXM capability, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The Alpine Premium Audio System and rear-view auto-dimming mirror further elevate a cabin designed for both daily use and weekends away. The Gladiator also has a reconfigurable 7-inch driver-information display, Bluetooth voice commands and steering-wheel audio controls.The $250 Trailer-Tow Package adds a Class IV receiver hitch, trailer hitch zoom, heavy-duty engine cooling and a 240-amp alternator. These factory provisions improve its usefulness for compatible trailers and recreation equipment; actual towing limits depend on the truck and loaded configuration. A five-foot pickup bed, tie-down points and lockable storage contribute everyday versatility.Overland comfort includes Black cloth bucket seats, driver lumbar adjustment, automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, power windows and locks, and a universal garage-door opener. The four-door cabin accommodates five passengers, with practical storage behind and beneath the rear seating. The removable hardtop and Jeep's iconic fold-down-windshield design add a sense of freedom most midsize trucks cannot match.Car and Driver placed the 2020 Gladiator on its 10Best list and named it an Editors' Choice, recognizing its combination of authentic off-road capability and pickup-truck utility. MotorTrend also praised the Overland's more comfort-oriented take on the Gladiator formula.The original factory window sticker confirms $5,205 in options: automatic transmission ($2,000), premium navigation/audio ($1,595), Freedom Top ($1,195), Trailer-Tow Package ($250) and all-weather slush mats ($165).
